newsitem.title: USA: Texaco sets new international downstream team.
newsitem.headline: Texaco sets new international downstream team.

text.p: Texaco Inc on Tuesday named a number of new executives to head its international marketing and manufacturing units.
The reorganization is part of Texaco's broader restructuring along business lines, announced last year.
President of the the marketing and manufacturing group is Clarence Cazalot, a vice president of Texaco Inc.

The international marketing unit is headed by Eugene Celentano, with the following regional vice presidents: Roger Ebert, U.K./Ireland; Paul Van de Walle, European Continent; Carey McHugh, Caribbean/Central America; Kenneth Knatz, South America (Andean region); Tony Blevins, South America (Cone region); James Hawn, West Africa.
Also in the international marketing group, Gerald Cherry is named general manager for operations and Gerald Brisson is director of market research and development.
Head of international manufacturing is Wayne Clark, with the following new refinery heads: Roland Kell, Pembroke, U.K.; William Livingston, Panama.
